items.title: Pay for professional cleaning (kitchen and bathroom)
items.quote: Please pay this amount within 14 days of receiving this letter.
items.computation: The 14-day period runs from the day the letter was received (not from any printed document date), per §§ 187(1), 188(2) BGB days-after-receipt counting. However, the letter carries no printed date at all, and the actual delivery/receipt date is not stated anywhere in the text or known to the recipient. Without either anchor, the start of the 14-day period cannot be fixed, so the exact due date cannot be computed. If the letter had been received on, say, the day it was read, the deadline would fall 14 days later, shifted to the next business day if it landed on a weekend/holiday in NW — but the actual receipt date must be supplied to compute this.

warnings: The letter itself carries no printed date, and no received-date is known, so the 14-day payment deadline cannot be computed exactly — note down the day you actually received this letter to fix the due date (14 days later, moved to the next business day if that falls on a weekend or NW public holiday).

The letter ties return of the deposit to payment of this cleaning invoice; check your tenancy agreement and the handover protocol to confirm the landlord was entitled to commission this cleaning and deduct/charge its cost before paying.

The IBAN given (DE95 3705 0198 0005 5505 00) is a validly formatted German IBAN, but a valid IBAN only confirms the format, not that the account belongs to this landlord — verify it against a previous invoice or the tenancy contract before transferring money.
